selected_hypothesis: CAT PEAD conditioned on backlog-to-dealer-inventory conversion quality
economic_mechanism: For a cyclical equipment manufacturer, an EPS beat is more likely to persist when firm end-demand backlog grows materially faster than channel inventory and pricing offsets manufacturing costs; otherwise the surprise may be channel fill or temporary margin timing already captured by the signal-day move.
falsifier: Reject or park unless current-quarter primary fields, canonical historical known-at vintages, at least five independent executable touches in every standard window, a valid novelty axis, and incremental replacement value over the unconditioned PEAD candidate all survive D0-D3.
portfolio_constraint: BULL regime and four reported core slots do not create execution authority; zero live signals and position control blockers make cash the current executable winner.
